contracts: The Exact Cover validator confirms both directions for every Atomic Obligation-to-runtime-evidence relationship and reports no orphaned node.

The dedicated assertion tests must cover the observable intent of ["py", "-3", "-m", "pytest", ".agents/skills/vdd-conformance-exact-cover/tests/validators/exact_cover.py"] using bounded fixtures, explicit arguments and expected exit/verdict assertions. Help output, a schema document alone, or an unstarted validator cannot prove the bound acceptance. Do not invoke live backends or mutate the real repository in a negative fixture.

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
